subject: Cross-border transfer execution plan & sprint ownership
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@meridianhealth.com>
To: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: privacy@aurora-cloud.com
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: initial ask - SCCs, UK addendum, and TIA scoping

Thanks Markus — quick context: Meridian is closing our procurement window next week and we need a concrete execution plan for international transfers before legal signs off. The core asks from our side: a) a short summary of which SCCs/clauses Redwood will rely on, b) whether you can execute the UK IDTA/UK Addendum (we need an editable draft and a negotiated cadence), and c) a clear TIA/DTIA scoping matrix that maps routes by customer region + subprocessors.

High-level timeline: procurement needs evidence to present on Tue 5/11. Can you confirm what you can deliver and who owns each piece? Also flag any potential blockers (subprocessor approvals, onshore-only routing exceptions).

Thanks — Alyssa
Alyssa Chen
Head of Procurement, Meridian Health
alyssa.chen@meridianhealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: none (referred internal doc)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: alyssa.chen@meridianhealth.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-border transfer execution plan & sprint ownership

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the clear timeline. We can meet the 5/11 procurement checkpoint with a concise package if we run a short internal sprint this week. Proposed split below. Happy to adjust if Meridian prefers different owners.

Deliverables (what we'll provide):
- Redwood_SCCs_summary.pdf — one-page summary of the SCC basis + any augmentation clauses we apply (by 5/06)
- UK_IDTA_draft_v1.docx — editable UK Addendum we can start negotiating (by 5/07)
- TIA_scope_matrix.xlsx — routing + subprocessor mapping for EU/UK/US + recommended mitigations (by 5/08)

Suggested owners:
- SCCs summary: Kimberly Park (legal/infra interface)
- UK IDTA draft: Laura Bennett (privacy counsel)
- TIA scoping matrix: Jordan Blake (data transfer ops)

Potential blockers we are watching: subprocessor access logs for a third-party CDN (we may need a short attestation), and for a small set of customers we currently route through our APAC aggregator — if Meridian requires onshore-only for EEA data we’ll note exceptions and suggested fallback.

Will start the internal coordination now and loop you as we post the docs.

— Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Legal & Privacy (on transfer ops)
Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: none
From: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-border transfer execution plan & sprint ownership

Markus — confirmed. I've pulled the latest SCCs mapping and drafted a one-page summary. Attaching the PDF and the working UK Addendum (v1). Notes:

- SCCs approach: we rely on the 2021 EU SCCs (controller-processor modules) with two operational addenda: 1) logging & access controls (read-only attestation), 2) routing fallbacks for in-region residency requests. The summary calls out the fallback behavior and the SLA impact.
- UK IDTA: the draft is standard with our audit/certification clauses left editable — suggest Meridian redline the custody and logging paragraphs.
- Subprocessors: the matrix will show three tiers (core infra, CDN/cache, analytics). CDN attestation is available but will require a short turnaround from our partner (48–72h).

I'm uploading: Redwood_SCCs_summary.pdf, UK_IDTA_draft_v1.docx. Jordan — please start the TIA matrix and include current subprocessor versions and last-attestation dates. I'll shepherd the legal points with Meridian.

Thanks, Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Privacy Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Redwood_SCCs_summary.pdf; UK_IDTA_draft_v1.docx
From: jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-border transfer execution plan & sprint ownership

On it — initial TIA_scope_matrix.xlsx (first tab = route mapping) is attached. Quick highlights:

- EU -> US: default route uses Redwood-hosted clusters in us-west with SCCs + encryption-in-transit. Subprocessors: core infra (Redwood-managed), CDN (FastCache Inc.), analytics (EventLogger Ltd.).
- UK: recommend UK Addendum in tandem with SCCs for firms that require UK IDTA. We surface an explicit option to bind the UK Addendum if Meridian requires it.
- Exceptions: three Meridian product flows touch APAC aggregator for logging; if Meridian requires strict EEA-only processing we can set the routing flag but will increase latency/cost.

I've included a column for last attestation date and a target due date to get the CDN attestation (target 5/06). Laura — can you review the legal columns and confirm the custody language suggested by Kimberly?

Jordan
Jordan Blake
Product Ops, Data Transfers
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: TIA_scope_matrix.xlsx
From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: alyssa.chen@meridianhealth.com, markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-border transfer execution plan & sprint ownership

Alyssa — attaching the three deliverables (SCCs summary, UK Addendum v1, and the TIA matrix). Short read — the SCCs summary calls out the fallback behavior for onshore routing and the impact on SLA. Operational asks for Meridian: please confirm whether you require the UK Addendum to be executed for Meridian accounts or whether SCCs alone are acceptable. That decision will change the contract flow but not the technical mapping.

Next steps we propose:
- Meridian to confirm: UK Addendum required? (reply by EOD 5/06)
- Redwood to secure CDN attestation (target 5/06)
- We prepare a DocuSign packet with the UK Addendum + DPA redlines once Meridian confirms (target 5/07)
- Final evidence packet to procurement for 5/11 checkpoint

I can assemble the DocuSign packet — Kimberly, can you provide the final clause set to drop into the packet? Markus — happy to lead communications with Meridian counsel if you want me in the thread.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Privacy Counsel
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
